orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPMS No. 989 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Singh, Advocate for 
the petitioners. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notices to the respondents 
fixing 17.05.2019. 
Steps be taken within a week. 
Also heard on the stay application. 
Having heard and learned counsel 
for the petitioners and after perusal of 
the papers brought on record, as an 
interim measure, it is directed that till 
the next date of listing further 
proceedings of Execution Case No. 16 of 
2000, Kishan Lal Bobal through LRs. Vs. 
Darveshwar Prasad through LRs. 
Pending in the court of 2nd Additional 
Civil Judge (Sr.Div.) Dehradun shall 
remain stayed. 
Stay application stands disposed of. 
Let a certified copy of the order be 
supplied to the counsel for the 
petitioners today itself on payment of 
usual charges. 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
Parul 09.04.2019

Mr. D.S. Negi, learned counsel i/b Mr. Siddhartha 
Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Raghav Singhal, learned counsel i/b Mr. Piyush 
Garg, learned counsel for respondents.
Amendment Application (IA/4704/2024)
Substitution Application (IA/4705/2024)
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner does not want to 
press these applications. Accordingly, both these 
applications are dismissed as not pressed.
Misc. Application (IA/4707/2025)
4. This application has been filed by the respondents 
whereby they informed the learned counsel for the 
petitioners about the death of petitioner no.1. The 
information is taken on record. The application stands 
disposed of.
Delay Condn. Application (IA/4708/2025)
Setting Aside Abatement Application (IA/4709/2025)
Substitution Application (IA/4710/2025)
5. These applications along with delay condonation 
have been moved for setting aside the abatement as well as 
to bring on record the legal heirs of respondent no.1/1. 
There is no opposition from the side of respondent to these 
applications. Accordingly, all these applications are 
allowed. Delay in filing the substitution application is 
condoned. The abatement is set aside. Let the necessary 
substitution be carried out in the memo of parties as per 
rules by supplying the memo.
6. List on 18.11.2025.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 14.10.2025 R.Dang
